title: Integral formula for the real $L^p$ norm
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal A,\mu)$ be a measure space, let $f:X\to\mathbb R$, and let $p>0$. If $f$ belongs to $L^p(\mu)$, then its $L^p$ norm is $\left(\int_X |f(x)|^p\,d\mu(x)\right)^{1/p}$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ is equipped with a measurable space structure
